tasks.label: DCDart: build current file
tasks.command: source core/scripts/dcdart-env.sh >/dev/null && dart core/dcc/bin/dcc.dart build --mode bare --target host "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o" --emit-header "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.h" && echo "built ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o + .h"

tasks.label: DCDart: build current file (freestanding, bare-x86_64)
tasks.command: source core/scripts/dcdart-env.sh >/dev/null && dart core/dcc/bin/dcc.dart build --mode bare --target bare-x86_64 "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bare.o" && echo "built ${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bare.o"

tasks.label: DCDart: verify freestanding (rule 1)
tasks.detail: Builds the open file for bare-x86_64 and runs nm -u against the allowlist. A green suite with a runtime symbol leak is a FAILED change.
tasks.command: source core/scripts/dcdart-env.sh >/dev/null && dart core/dcc/bin/dcc.dart build --mode bare --target bare-x86_64 "${file}" -o "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bare.o" && cd core && bash scripts/verify-freestanding.sh "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.bare.o"

tasks.label: DCDart: first-time setup (restore vendored frontend)
tasks.detail: Required after a fresh clone -- core/frontend/vendor/ is gitignored and nothing resolves until this runs.
